Gemeinderat no. 2 of 09.02.2026: 'Genehmigung der Verordnung zur Regelung des Parkens, des Campierens und anderer Formen von Übernachtungen'. Body, number, date and wording match; no amounts or locations stated.
Gemeindeausschuss no. 201 of 20.04.2026: 'Betrieb der Parkplätze in der Gemeinde Graun. Festlegung der Tarife der gebührenpflichtigen Parkplätze und der Ausnahmegenehmigungen.' Matches; no amounts.
Gemeinderat no. 47 of 29.09.2025: 'Betrieb der Parkplätze der Gemeinde Graun im Vinschgau'. Matches.

Gemeindeausschuss no. 173 of 19.04.2022 ('Erhöhung der Gebühren für den Parkplatz Reschen 13 Piz') and no. 260 of 23.05.2022 ('... Parkplatz Graun 8 Turm'), both titled as amendments of own decision no. 235 of 26.04.2021 'Betrieb der Parkplätze'. All numbers and dates match. Decision 235/2021 itself is not in the register (the listing starts 25.10.2021); it is known only from these titles. The closing sentence about 2026 possibly replacing the fees is a hedge, not a claim.

Gemeindeausschuss no. 176 of 19.04.2022 'Genehmigung der Verlängerung der Vereinbarung mit der Schöneben AG betreffend die Führung des Parkplatzes in "Piz"' and no. 317 of 12.06.2023 'Genehmigung einer Vereinbarung mit der Schöneben AG betreffend die Führung des Parkplatzes in "Piz"'. Numbers and dates right. Not supported: 'is run' (present tense; titles only record approvals), 'new agreement' (title says 'a' agreement, not new), 'in Reschen' and 'the Reschen-Piz lift site' (those two titles say only 'Piz'; the Reschen link comes from the separate fee title no. 173).
items.corrected_text: On 19 April 2022 (decision no. 176) the municipal executive approved an extension of the agreement with Schöneben AG on the running of the car park 'Piz', and on 12 June 2023 (decision no. 317) it approved an agreement with Schöneben AG on the running of the car park 'Piz'. The register lists only the titles; the terms and the current status are not published. A separate fee decision of 19 April 2022 (no. 173) concerns the car park 'Reschen 13 Piz'.

items.note: Gemeindeausschuss: no. 196 of 20.04.2026 (FY2025), no. 199 of 28.04.2025 (FY2024), no. 204 of 29.04.2024 (FY2023), no. 263 of 15.05.2023 (FY2022), no. 459 of 06.09.2022 (FY2021), all 'Genehmigung der Rechnungslegung betreffend die Einhebung der Gebühren für den öffentlichen Parkplatz'. Giovacchini Time Solutions, Bozen'; no. 104 of 18.03.2024 'Reparatur Parkscheinautomat "Turm" nach Blitzschlag' (order to Fuchs Technik); no. 95 of 11.03.2024 'Ankauf von zwei Parkscheinautomaten' (Giovacchini). Not supported: 'two more' (title says two machines, not additional), 'lightning strike in March 2024' (18 March 2024 is the order date, strike date unstated), 'by the sunken church tower' (the title says only 'Turm'; other titles say 'Kirchturm im See'). Also the summary's 'has expanded electronic payment' overstates: June 2026 is the order, completion not stated.
items.corrected_text: The register shows orders for pay-and-display machines (Parkscheinautomaten): one machine bought on 18 July 2022 (no. 347), two machines on 11 March 2024 (no. 95), a repair of the machine 'Turm' after a lightning strike ordered on 18 March 2024 (no. 104) and maintenance on 9 March 2026 (no. 115). On 29 June 2026 (no. 362) the executive commissioned Giovacchini Time Solutions of Bolzano to extend the system for electronic payment at the 'Parkuhr'. The register lists only the decision titles; completion of the extension is not stated and no amounts or locations are given.

items.note: Gemeindeausschuss no. 546 of 18.11.2024 'Umgestaltung und Erweiterung des öffentlichen Parkplatzes und Bau von Infrastrukturen der Bushaltestelle und der dazugehörigen öffentlichen Grünflächen in Graun - Genehmigung der Bescheinigung über die ordnungsgemäße Ausführung der Arbeiten'; award of works to Marx GmbH in no. 340 of 26.06.2023 (June 2023 confirmed). Number, dates and wording right except 'new bus stop': the title says 'construction of infrastructure of the bus stop', and other titles of the same project say 'Umgestaltung der Bushaltestelle' (redesign), so 'new' is not supported.
items.corrected_text: In Graun the municipality redesigned and extended the public car park and built infrastructure for the bus stop and the associated public green areas (title: 'Umgestaltung und Erweiterung des öffentlichen Parkplatzes und Bau von Infrastrukturen der Bushaltestelle und der dazugehörigen öffentlichen Grünflächen in Graun'). The executive awarded the works on 26 June 2023 (decision no. 340) and approved the certificate of proper execution on 18 November 2024 (decision no. 546/2024). The register lists only the decision titles; no amounts or locations are stated.

corrected_summary: Research on Curon Venosta (Graun im Vinschgau) rests only on the municipality's own register of executive and council decisions, which lists decision titles without documents, amounts or locations; the tourism sites could not be opened. The register shows that the municipality runs paid car parks with numbered names such as 'Graun 8 Turm' and 'Reschen 13 Piz', raised the fees for those two car parks in April and May 2022, took a council decision on the operation of its car parks on 29 September 2025, approved an ordinance on parking, camping and other overnight stays on 9 February 2026, and set tariffs and exemption permits for the paid car parks on 20 April 2026. It approved an agreement with Schöneben AG on running the car park 'Piz' in 2022 (extension) and 2023, and each year approves the accounts of the parking fee collection. Between 2023 and 2026 it worked on car parks at the former ANAS site in Reschen (certificate of execution approved September 2024), in Graun together with bus stop infrastructure (November 2024) and at Maseben in Langtaufers (final account approved September 2026). In 2026 it approved a project for a bus stop at the location Piz in Reschen, approved a project and a first variant for demolishing and rebuilding the lift installation Reschen - Piz-Schöneben, commissioned an extension of electronic payment at the parking meters (29 June 2026) and ran a tender for allocating municipal land for EV charging stations (May 2026). No tariff amounts, occupancy figures or press coverage could be verified.
